mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transport_route ( route_no, route_code, departure_campus, arrival_campus, estimated_duration_minutes, status, version, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{routeNumber}, #{routeCode}, #{departureCampus}, #{arrivalCampus}, #{estimatedDurationMinutes}, #{status}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, route_no, route_code, departure_campus, arrival_campus, estimated_duration_minutes, status, version, created_at, updated_at FROM transport_route WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, route_no, route_code, departure_campus, arrival_campus, estimated_duration_minutes, status, version, created_at, updated_at FROM transport_route WHERE route_code = #{routeCode}
